trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Checked current state** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%.
2. **Got change-manager approval** — since v2.3.2 had never been deployed and shown health in production, policy required approval before shipping it. The change-manager approved.
3. **Deployed v2.3.2** to all production regions — rollout completed (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
4. **Verified health** — service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%, down from 18%.
5. **Opened SEV3 incident** — INC-0001 is open, documenting the change and post-deploy health; the on-call engineer has been paged.
